text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's that most festive day of the year, and apparently, Hishi Akebono has prepared a feast for us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing her, I have no doubt she's readied a huge volume of scrumptious food.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since it's a special occasion, I buy some slightly fancy soft drinks for us, then hurry back to the academy under the winter sky.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, welcome back! I just finished preparing the food!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I expect to see a huge earthenware pot on the table, but instead, I see platters filled with things like marinated foods, omelets, and cheese.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Are you surprised? This is called "antipasto."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's a type of Italian appetizer. Remember how my family runs an Italian restaurant?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, I thought it would be fitting to have an Italian-style feast to celebrate today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Different dishes are arranged on plates, with each one brought out in turn.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's really fun seeing everything brought out, so I figured it'd be fun to try having a meal in that style!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're welcome. Okay, shall we dig in? ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So starts the special dinner that Hishi Akebono kindly prepared for us!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Next, for our primo piatto, we haaave cannelloni!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Cannelloni is a kind of pasta dish. It's a holiday staple for my family.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The cheese might be a little hot, so maybe blow on it before you eat it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And for our secondo piatto, roast chicken! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: This is our main course today, so I've been pouring all my effort into it since last night!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I cooked some veggies as side dishes for it, too. They taste buono with the meat, so make sure you try them!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Lastly, we have panettone for dessert! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's a classic dessert for any Italian winter celebration! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The dried fruits make it sweet and buono! Let's have some!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She cuts a slice of panettone for me and, after taking a bite, I relish the sweet and mild taste as it fills my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmmm! It really is buono! I love how sweet and fluffy it is!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm glad everything turned out tasty! Phew, I'm so full! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After our meal, we sip on the drinks I bought and sit together savoring the aftertaste of our dinner.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I'm glad it was just the two of us today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I wasn't sure if I wanted to hold a party today or not.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I was thinking it'd be fun to be with everyone, and to have some hot pot, and share a biiig cake.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But then I thought about how I used to celebrate the holidays quietly with just my parents.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So I wanted to make today a day for relaxing and creating wonderful memories with family.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's why I thought it would be a good idea to celebrate the holidays with you, privately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And it turns out I made the right choice! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's do this again next year, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Relaxing in peace, Hishi Akebono and I share a precious and irreplaceable moment in time together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I hope I can spend the holidays with you like this next year, and the year after that, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I would be… Um…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, I'd be really happy if you felt the same way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I start to answer that I'd be happy to celebrate the holiday together again, but before I can get the words out…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I completely forgot! I haven't put the star on top of the tree yet!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It was really hard, so I put it off, but then I totally forgot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Really? Yay! I'm counting on you, then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The tree's really high, so you might not be able to reach the top. Here, I'll lift you up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: HUP!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She braces herself with a war cry, then hefts me up in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Do you think you can reach it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she holds me firmly in both arms…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I make a wish upon the star that Hishi Akebono and I will be able to celebrate the holidays again next year… then carefully place it atop the tree.
